title: What time is it：几点了
story: 外国朋友问你 What time is it? 你只会说 yes？这一课学会报时三件套：整点、半点、还有最帅的一句 It's about time!（该出发啦）！
explore: half past 是过半还是没到？

blocks.title: 两问一答
blocks.text: 问：What time is it?（几点了？）/ What's the time?；答：It's + 时间——It's seven.（七点了）· It's seven o'clock.（七点整）：o'clock 只用于整点——「七点半」绝不能说 seven o'clock

items.label: 整点
items.value: 数字 + o'clock：7:00 = seven o'clock（七点整）：几点整几点说·最简单

items.label: 半点
items.value: half past + 数字：7:30 = half past seven（七过一半）：half=一半·past=过了——七点过了一半

blocks.text: 整点加 o'clock·半点 half past

blocks.title: 一天六句话
blocks.text: I get up at seven o'clock. 七点起；I go to school at eight. 八点上学；Lunch at twelve! 十二点午饭；I play at four o'clock. 四点玩；Homework at half past seven. 七点半作业；I sleep at nine. 九点睡——用六个时间点把一天串起来

blocks.title: at 是时间钩子
blocks.text: 说「在几点」要加 at：at seven·at half past nine——at 像一枚图钉把时间和动作钉在一起：记住口诀：几点做事 at 打头
at + 时间——把动作钉在时间上

items.label: 问路遇
items.value: —What time is it? —It's half past three. Let's go!（三点半了·走吧！）

items.label: 约朋友
items.value: —See you at five o'clock? —OK! At five.（五点见？——好·五点！）

items.label: 迟到了
items.value: —Oh no, it's nine o'clock! —Hurry up!（九点了！——快点！）

blocks.title: about 差不多
blocks.text: It's about seven.（七点左右）——about=大约：不确切的时间用 about 打头·最地道的口语缓冲词：时间没掐准也能大方开口

sections.title: 问与答
sections.body:
【问】What time is it?
【答】It's + 时间。
【整点】数字+o'clock。

sections.title: 半点
sections.body:
【句型】half past + 数字。
【理解】half 一半·past 过了。
【例】7:30=half past seven。

sections.title: 作息表达
sections.body:
【介词】在几点用 at。
【缓冲】about=大约。
【例】at seven·about nine。

mistakes: 七点半说成 seven o'clock（o'clock 只用于整点）
忘了在时间前加 at（at seven 才对）

exercises.q: It's about nine 的意思是？
